description: Suno Studio effect. Tilt EQ, tape-style soft saturation, and a band-limited squeeze for old-radio, lo-fi vocal character. Apply to rendered audio inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Tilt EQ, tape-style soft saturation, and a band-limited squeeze for old-radio, lo-fi vocal character.

tilt.description: Single tilt control: boosts lows and cuts highs (or the reverse when negative).
tilt.label: Tilt

drive.description: Pre-saturation gain into the tanh tape stage.
drive.label: Drive

lowCut.description: Highpass corner that removes low rumble for the lo-fi squeeze.
lowCut.label: Low Cut

highCut.description: Lowpass corner that rolls off the top for the lo-fi squeeze.
highCut.label: High Cut

dry/wet mix.description: Blend between dry input and processed signal.
dry/wet mix.label: Mix

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
